cards.title: The eval harness
cards.text: The one place that knows how an eval runs, so an eval set only says what it asks and how it grades.

cards.title: An eval is a class
cards.text: It names its modes, its dataset and its checks. A dataset is a folder of scenarios.

cards.title: Trials
cards.text: One conversation per mode, repeat and scenario, kept as its transcript.

cards.title: Checks and metrics
cards.text: General checks and a model judge grade a trial. Metrics measure it.

cards.title: One protocol
cards.text: Every event written once, as one JSON line, for the API and the studio to read.

cards.title: The judge's calibration
cards.text: A label sheet people fill in, and how far the judge agrees with them.
